title_ar: Kafka والـstreaming: رحلة معاملة Mobile Money واحدة (2/2)
title_en: Kafka and streaming, and one Mobile Money transaction: offsets, lag, delivery, Nextgen D&IM flows (part 2 of 2)
how_to_read: sentences[].w = first..last word id inside this chapter; word k (0-based) of the sentence is first+k and `ar` is the spoken text (its space-separated tokens are those words); fr = [start_frame, end_frame] at 24 fps from the word map; impact = hook words (id=text); num = spoken numbers with data-contract fact ids; first_mention = glossary terms to chip (id=term); dup = same claim in another chapter. Anchor with {word, lead_frames} only. Visual candidates are ideas, never footage.

constraints.anchors: {word, lead_frames} only; never seconds or frames; event frame = word start - lead_frames
constraints.lead_frames: kinetic word -3, graphic state change -2, shot cut -4..-6 (inside a pause >= 200 ms), counter starts at the number word
constraints.density: >= 20 events/min; no gap > 4 s without an event (hold <= 6 s with reason); shot median 6-12 s, max 25 s (shots > 12 s: an event every 3 s)
constraints.coverage: every sentence >= 1 anchored event; >= 80 % of sentences a mechanism event; every spoken number and every first-mention term on screen
constraints.kinetic: 8-20 kinetic words per minute; <= 6 words and <= 2 lines on screen; impact word 1-2 words
constraints.fx: hero (real-time 3D) <= 5 % of chapter frames (ADR-002 RT5); fx_tier lite|standard|hero
constraints.text: text on busy backgrounds needs a plate or halo; sizes and safe areas: 04 sections 3.2 and 3.4
banned: invented numbers (every number: data-contract id or source sentence)
constraints.components: use only frozen components (harness/schemas/components/); requests go to corpus/specs/_component_requests.jsonl
constraints.chapter_rhythm: problem -> mental model -> progressive visual -> worked example -> prediction -> failure (crit) -> fix (ok) -> callback -> artifact (per chapter, not per sentence)

sentences.ar: وطبعاً لو في رسالة مسممة بتوقع الـconsumer كل شوية بتتحول فوراً لـdead letter queue أو DLQ عشان المسار يفضل شغال وما يقفش
sentences.en: And of course a poisoned message that keeps crashing the consumer is immediately moved to a dead letter queue, or DLQ, so the path keeps running and does not stop.

sentences.ar: ولو بصينا على الكود من جوة هنلاقي الـPySpark بيقرى الـstreams من port 9092
sentences.en: Looking at the code from inside, we find PySpark reading streams from port 9092.

sentences.ar: وبيجمع الداتا دي في windows او شبابيك زمنية مدتها خمس دقائق بـtrigger كل دقيقة
sentences.en: It groups this data into time windows lasting five minutes, with a trigger every minute.

sentences.ar: الحتة الصائعة هنا هي الـwatermark اللي متزبط على عشر دقائق
sentences.en: The key piece here is the watermark, which is set to ten minutes.

sentences.ar: وده معناه ببساطة ان النظام هيدي فرصة عشر دقائق للأحداث المتأخرة انها توصل قبل ما يقفل الشباك تماما
sentences.en: Meaning, the system gives late events ten minutes to arrive before it fully closes the window.

sentences.ar: المحطة الثالثة رحلة بطل القصة أو المعاملة
sentences.en: Third station: the journey of the story's hero, the transaction.

sentences.ar: خلونا نركز كلنا على الرقم ده TXN -99482 دي معاملة تحويل مالي حقيقية بالقرش
sentences.en: Let's all focus on this number, TXN-99482, a real money transfer accurate to the piaster.

sentences.ar: حد داس ارسال والنظام التشغيلي سجل المبلغ والاطراف وطلع لنا رقم المعاملة الجميل ده
sentences.en: Someone pressed send, and the operating system recorded the amount and the parties and produced this lovely transaction number.

sentences.ar: الرقم ده هو الخيط اللي هنفضل ماسكينه ومتبعينه في كل محطة جوه المعمارية بتاعتنا عشان نسبة عملياً إزاي الداتا الحقيقية بتتحرك
sentences.en: This number is the thread we will keep holding and tracking at every station inside our architecture, to show practically how real data moves.

sentences.ar: أول حاجة وده وقت ما الحدث حصل فعلياً
sentences.en: First, the time the event actually happened.

sentences.ar: بعدين وقت ما المنصة بتاعتنا استلمته التالت وقت المعالجة
sentences.en: Then the time our platform received it; third, the processing time.

sentences.ar: والرابع وقت ما بقى متاح في تقرير نقدر نشوفه.
sentences.en: And fourth, the time it became available in a report we can see.

sentences.ar: الخلط بين الأوقات دي واعتبرهم حاجة واحدة هو الفخ اللي بيوقع ناس كتير ويعمل اختلافات في الأرقام واحنا بندور وراء المشاكل
sentences.en: Mixing these times up and treating them as one is the trap that catches many people and creates differences in the numbers while we chase problems.

sentences.ar: المحطة الرابعة مكونات الـNext Gen Architecture جوه المنصة
sentences.en: Fourth station: the components of the Next Gen Architecture inside the platform.

sentences.ar: البيانات بتتنقل بين مستويات لو بصنا على الشمال هنلاقي طبقة الـ ODS أو جداول الـ TO.
sentences.en: Data moves between levels; looking at the left we find the ODS layer, or the TO tables.

sentences.ar: دي بتفضل قريبة جدا من شكل الداتا الأصلي في المصدر وبتتحدث بشكل شبه لحظي Near Real Time.
sentences.en: They stay very close to the shape of the original data at the source and are updated in near real time.

sentences.ar: ولما نروح لليمين بندخل في طبقة الـ ADS أو جداول الـ TA
sentences.en: On the right we enter the ADS layer, or the TA tables.

sentences.ar: هنا بنحط الـ Business Logic بتاعنا ونطلع بيانات مجمعة ومحسوبة وجهزة للتقارير
sentences.en: Here we put our business logic and produce aggregated, calculated data ready for reports.

sentences.ar: لو فككنا مكونات الـ Next Gen D&IM الحقيقية دي بالوظيفة الأول وبعدين المنتج هنلاقي الآتي
sentences.en: If we break down the components of Next Gen D&IM by function first and then product, we find the following.

sentences.ar: للتوزيع اللحظي للأحداث بنعتمد على Kafka بيشيل لحد 10,000 حركة في الثانية
sentences.en: For real-time event distribution we rely on Kafka, which carries up to 10,000 transactions per second.

sentences.ar: للمعالجة اللحظية بطلنا هو Flink للـbatch والتقارير التقيلة Spark
sentences.en: For real-time processing our hero is Flink, and for batch and heavy reports, Spark.

sentences.ar: للـAPIs بنستخدم GaussDB
sentences.en: For the APIs we use GaussDB.

sentences.ar: أما التخزين العملاق فده بيروح لـ HDFS بمساحة مهولة بتوصل لـ 352 تيرابايت
sentences.en: The huge storage goes to HDFS, with a massive capacity reaching 352 terabytes.

sentences.ar: كل دولة معزولة تماماً في قواعد بياناتها الخاصة
sentences.en: Each country is completely isolated in its own databases.

sentences.ar: والشيء الوحيد اللي بيجمعهم هو الـKafka bus اللي بينقل الداتا بسرعة الصاروخ
sentences.en: The only thing that joins them is the Kafka bus, moving data at rocket speed.

sentences.ar: المحطة الخامسة التدفقات الأربعة للبيانات
sentences.en: Fifth station: the four data flows.

sentences.ar: الداتا بتخرج من المنصة دي عن طريق أربع مسارات أو تدفقات أساسية
sentences.en: Data leaves this platform through four main paths, or flows.

sentences.ar: الأول الـ Central Kafka وده مخصص للأنظمة المركزية التقيلة زي أنظمة كشف الاحتيال
sentences.en: First, Central Kafka, dedicated to heavy central systems such as fraud detection systems.

sentences.ar: التاني الـ Local Kafka وده بيخدم تطبيقات كل الدولة بشكل محلي
sentences.en: Second, Local Kafka, which serves each country's applications locally.

sentences.ar: التالت الـ API Out وده بيرجع الداتا بصيغة JSON بحد أقصى ألف سجل للطلب الواحد
sentences.en: Third, API Out, which returns data as JSON with a maximum of one thousand records per request.

sentences.ar: والرابع والأخير مسار الـ File Out وده المسار الليلي الهادي اللي بيبعت ملفات عن طريق SFTP بين الساعة 2 والساعة 5 صباحا
sentences.en: And fourth and last, the File Out path, the quiet nightly path that sends files over SFTP between 2 and 5 AM.

sentences.ar: المحطة السادسة والأخيرة الـdashboards الـSLAs والفواتير
sentences.en: Sixth and last station: the dashboards, the SLAs and the invoices.

sentences.ar: تعالوا نعيش يوم في حياة بطلتنا المعاملة المالية
sentences.en: Let's live a day in the life of our heroine, the financial transaction.

sentences.ar: عملية التحويل بتحصل وخلال أقل من 5 دقايق وده الـSLA صارم بتاعنا
sentences.en: The transfer happens, and within less than 5 minutes, which is our strict SLA.

sentences.ar: المعاملة بتسمع في التقرير اللحظي الدنيا بتهدى
sentences.en: The transaction shows up in the real-time report, and things calm down.

sentences.ar: وبالليل الساعة 2 بيبدأ مسار الـbatch التقيل
sentences.en: At night at 2 the heavy batch path begins.

sentences.ar: وقبل الساعة 3 بتكون كل ملفات الامتثال أو الـcompliance اتصدرت
sentences.en: Before 3 all the compliance files have been exported.

sentences.ar: وعلى الساعة 5 الفجر بتكون كل التقارير تسلمت للأنظمة النهائية
sentences.en: And by 5 in the early morning all the reports have been delivered to the downstream systems.

sentences.ar: كل خطوة هنا محسوبة بالثانية
sentences.en: Every step here is measured to the second.

sentences.ar: الـCentral Kafka مثلاً لازم يخلص من 70 ثانية ل3 دقائق والـAPIs من 5 ل 15 دقيقة بكتير
sentences.en: Central Kafka for example must finish within 70 seconds to 3 minutes, and the APIs within 5 to 15 minutes at most.

sentences.ar: ودلوقتي لحظة الحقيقة اللي بتثبت قوة المعمارية دي كلها
sentences.en: And now the moment of truth that proves the strength of this whole architecture.

sentences.ar: مش معاملة شبهها ولا تجميع تقريبية هي بالزبط
sentences.en: Not a similar transaction nor an approximate aggregate, but exactly it.

sentences.ar: ده أكبر دليل إن الداتا تنقلت من أصلها الصغير جدا لحد الشاشات صناعة القرار بمنتهى الدقة والشفافية
sentences.en: This is the biggest proof that the data travelled from its tiny origin to the decision-making screens with utmost accuracy and transparency.

sentences.ar: وعشان نأكد على شغل الـbusiness logic في طبقة الـ ADS عندنا ستة فواتير تسجلوا على مدار اليوم
sentences.en: To confirm the business logic work in the ADS layer, we have six invoices recorded over the day.

sentences.ar: الحسبة البسيطة بتقول إن الإجمال الناجح هو 400 جنيه مصري متقسمين بمنتهى العدل
sentences.en: The simple calculation says the successful total is 400 Egyptian pounds, split fairly.

sentences.ar: الـoperator الأول ليه 250 والـoperator الثاني ليه 150
sentences.en: The first operator gets 250 and the second operator gets 150.

sentences.ar: النظام صنف العمليات وحسب الفلوس وطلع النتيجة مظبوطة بالقرش
sentences.en: The system classified the operations and by money produced a result accurate to the piaster.

sentences.ar: يعني نسبة النجاح الكلية لمعاملة اليوم ده هي 66.67%
sentences.en: Meaning the overall success rate for that day's transactions is 66.67%.

sentences.ar: ده تتويج الرقم المظبوط لرحلة الداتا الطويلة جوه شرايين الـstreaming والـKafka
sentences.en: This is the crowning exact number of the long data journey inside the arteries of streaming and Kafka.

sentences.ar: لو صحينا في يوم لقينا ان تقرير اتأخر وهدف الطزاجة أو الـ 5 -minute freshness SLA اتكسر
sentences.en: If we woke up one day and found a report delayed and the 5-minute freshness SLA broken.

sentences.ar: يا ترى لو رجعنا لأختام الوقت الأربعة اللي كلمنا عنهم
sentences.en: I wonder, if we go back to the four time stamps we talked about.

sentences.ar: أي ختم فيهم هو اللي امتص وصنع تأخير ده هل هو الـ ingestion time ولا الـ processing time؟
sentences.en: Which stamp absorbed and created this delay: is it the ingestion time or the processing time?

sentences.ar: إجابة السؤال ده هي اللي بتفرق بين مجرد كلام جميل في الـ presentations وبين تحكم هندسي حقيقي واحترافي في الـ real time data
sentences.en: The answer to this question is what separates pretty talk in presentations from real, professional engineering control over real time data.

sentences.ar: شكراً جداً لوقتكم ونتمنى الجولة دي تكون نوارة الصورة جوة عالم الـ streaming
sentences.en: Thank you very much for your time; we hope this tour lit up the picture inside the world of streaming.

facts.rule: A number goes on screen with its fact id as `ref`/`data_refs`. `unmatched_numbers` are spoken but have no data-contract fact: their source is the sentence itself (a valid `s:` ref); never replace them with a different figure.

referenced.ctx: If any of these fails to reconcile after a data change, the film is showing two datasets — stop and fix §6 before rendering.

glossary.rule: Explain the term in Egyptian Arabic the first time it appears; then use the original term naturally, in Latin script, inside Arabic sentences.
glossary.register_ar: Natural Egyptian, clear, calm, professional. Use إحنا and خلّينا نشوف and ببساطة where they help. No heavy Modern Standard Arabic. No exaggerated slang. Numbers are spoken naturally in Egyptian but displayed as Western digits.
glossary.register_en: Plain, direct, unhurried. Short sentences. No hype, no "imagine that…", no rhetorical questions that are not real prediction prompts. Say the number, then pause for half a beat before the next sentence — the pause is where the viewer reads the screen.
glossary.never_translate_rule: Explain them in Egyptian Arabic the first time they appear, then use the original term naturally.
glossary.on_screen: Western digits, Latin terms in LTR isolates, Egyptian Arabic copy (no MSA), no per-letter animation (04 section 3.4).

concepts.def_en: A side queue for messages that keep failing, so the main pipeline keeps flowing and the bad ones can be inspected later.
concepts.def_ar: الـDLQ طابور جانبي للرسايل اللي بتفشل على طول، عشان المسار الأساسي يكمّل شغل وتراجع الرسايل المعطوبة بعدين.
concepts.failure: Never monitoring the DLQ, so poisoned messages pile up unnoticed and data is silently lost.

concepts.def_en: A first-in, first-out collection: items are added at the back and removed from the front.
concepts.failure: Confusing FIFO queues with LIFO stacks, which changes the traversal order entirely.

concepts.def_en: A numbered endpoint on a machine that identifies which service receives network traffic,…
concepts.failure: Assuming a service is reachable just because it runs, without checking its port.

concepts.def_en: A marker of progress: in streams, how long to wait for late events before closing a windo…
concepts.failure: Setting the watermark too tight drops late events; too loose delays results and bloats st…

concepts.def_en: Operational Data Store: a layer close to the source that keeps its shape, holding raw dat…
concepts.failure: Using the ODS for long-term analytics instead of a short-retention raw layer.

concepts.def_en: The warehouse's top, application-facing layer: curated, analysis-ready tables that report…
concepts.failure: Querying raw ODS tables for dashboards instead of the curated ADS layer.

concepts.def_en: A distributed, append-only event log: producers write events to topics, consumers read fo…
concepts.failure: Treating Kafka as a database with a different name; it is a log with retention.

concepts.def_en: A group of records processed together in one run, as opposed to streaming; a batch identi…
concepts.failure: Rerunning a batch load without deleting that batch first, duplicating rows.

concepts.def_en: Apache Spark: a distributed engine that processes large datasets in parallel across a clu…
concepts.failure: Using Spark for small data, where cluster overhead outweighs any speed gain.

concepts.def_en: Interfaces through which programs call each other to request data or actions, typically o…
concepts.failure: Calling an API without handling errors, timeouts or rate limits.

concepts.def_en: Huawei's distributed relational database, built on MPP shared-nothing architecture, used…
concepts.failure: Using it like a single-node database and ignoring distribution key choice.

concepts.def_en: Hadoop Distributed File System: splits files into blocks spread across DataNodes and keep…
concepts.failure: Storing huge numbers of tiny files, which overload the NameNode's metadata memory.

concepts.def_en: A text format for nested key-value and list data, the common language of APIs.
concepts.failure: Assuming JSON keeps Python types like tuples or dates after a round trip.

concepts.def_en: Application Programming Interface: a defined contract through which one program requests…
concepts.failure: Changing a response field or meaning without versioning, breaking every client that depen…

concepts.def_en: SSH File Transfer Protocol: copies files between systems over an encrypted SSH connection, used here for the nightly file-out path.
concepts.def_ar: الـSFTP بروتوكول بينقل الملفات بين السيستمز على اتصال SSH مشفّر، وبنستخدمه هنا في مسار الـfile-out بالليل.
concepts.failure: Using plain FTP instead of SFTP, sending files and credentials unencrypted.

concepts.def_en: Service Level Agreement: a committed standard for a service, such as a deadline or availa…
concepts.failure: Setting an SLA without monitoring or alerts, so users discover breaches.

concepts.def_en: Processing data continuously as events arrive, instead of waiting to process it in period…
concepts.failure: Assuming events arrive on time and in order; late data breaks results.

concepts.def_en: How recent the data in a report or table is: the delay between an event happening and it being visible, checked against an SLA.
concepts.def_ar: الـfreshness يعني الداتا في التقرير حديثة قد إيه: الفرق بين حصول الحدث وظهوره، ومتقاس قصاد الـSLA.
concepts.failure: Checking that the pipeline ran, not how old the newest row is.

concepts.def_en: When the pipeline actually processes an event, after it happened and arrived; it drifts later than event time as load grows.
concepts.def_ar: الـprocessing time هو وقت ما الـpipeline بتعالج الحدث فعلاً، بعد ما حصل ووصل؛ وبيتأخر عن الـevent time لما الحمل يزيد.
concepts.failure: Aggregating by processing time, so delays shift events into the wrong period.

components.does: One whole word (or a tatweel-joined compound like الـKafka) on screen; never split per letter.
Up to 6 kinetic words on at most 2 lines, each word arriving on its own spoken word anchor.
A technical term chip (Latin in an LTR isolate) with an optional Arabic gloss; 28 px floor if spoken.
A counter that rolls from the previous value to the target over the spoken number (preset count).
An arrow from a label to a target layer (or a named part of it, 'layer.part').
Failure beat: glitch + low thud; flashes stay <= 3/s (WCAG 2.3.1).
Fix beat: the target settles into place with a settle chime.
The shot camera: move + ease + intensity; drift always on; optional impact nudges (<= 4 px) on anchors.
Match cut between a layer of this shot and one of the next.
Lower-third caption for a source, term, speaker or location.
Draw an SVG path (stroke reveal; RTL by default for Arabic layouts).
A request travelling hops (client, lb, service, cache, db, queue, external) with per-hop latency.
A data table (<= 8 columns, <= 12 visible rows); numbers come from a data_ref.
Deep-Dive entry card with parent chapter and prerequisite concepts.
